title: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
titleEn: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description: The Switch 2 Edition enhances resolution and frame rate, adds Advanced Scoring, Boost Up, CameraPlay support, and local GameShare while keeping the core boxing workout system. The Switch 2 Edition starts from the established Fitness Boxing 3 workout structure. GameShare allows local workout sharing to another compatible Nintendo system.

gameplayPillars.title: Enhanced performance
gameplayPillars.description: Nintendo explicitly states that the Switch 2 Edition increases resolution and frame rate.

gameplayPillars.title: Advanced Scoring Mode
gameplayPillars.description: A new scoring option evaluates hit timing more strictly.

gameplayPillars.title: Boost Up workouts
gameplayPillars.description: Workout speed can gradually increase round by round for added challenge.

gameplayPillars.title: CameraPlay support
gameplayPillars.description: Compatible camera use can show the player’s movements on screen during workouts.

gameplayPillars.title: GameShare local
gameplayPillars.description: Owners can share the game locally with another Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 system for supported sessions.
